{
  "decision-cite-operative-leak-handoff": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT bay_code, note_id, evidence_text, bay_action,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bay_code ORDER BY shift_min DESC, revision_no DESC) AS rn
  FROM handoff_notes
  WHERE posting_state = 'posted' AND shift_min <= 480
)
SELECT bay_code, note_id, evidence_text
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND bay_action = 'inspect'
ORDER BY bay_code;",
  "decision-cite-release-slips-at-packing-cutoff": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT f.file_path, s.source_id, s.slip_text,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY f.file_path
           ORDER BY s.posted_tick DESC, (s.file_path IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM print_file AS f
  JOIN release_slip AS s ON s.batch_code = f.batch_code
                        AND (s.file_path IS NULL OR s.file_path = f.file_path)
  WHERE s.posted_tick <= (SELECT cutoff_tick FROM packing_run)
)
SELECT file_path, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND substr(slip_text, 1, 8) = 'RELEASE '
ORDER BY file_path COLLATE BINARY;",
  "decision-close-followup-vendor-ledger": "WITH events AS (
  SELECT vendor_code, base_cents AS earned, 0 AS paid FROM call_work WHERE attempt_day <= 30
  UNION ALL
  SELECT vendor_code, bonus_cents, 0 FROM call_work WHERE accepted_day <= 30
  UNION ALL
  SELECT vendor_code, 0, cash_cents FROM cash_log WHERE paid_day <= 30
), totals AS (
  SELECT vendor_code, SUM(earned) AS earned_cents, SUM(paid) AS paid_cents
  FROM events
  GROUP BY vendor_code
)
SELECT vendor_code, earned_cents, paid_cents,
       MAX(earned_cents - paid_cents, 0) AS payable_cents,
       MAX(paid_cents - earned_cents, 0) AS advance_cents
FROM totals
ORDER BY vendor_code COLLATE BINARY;",
  "decision-close-prepaid-update-revenue": "WITH terms AS (
  SELECT series_code, span_periods, 4 - first_period AS period_in_term,
         fee_cents / span_periods AS base, fee_cents % span_periods AS extra_periods
  FROM prepaid_term
  WHERE first_period <= 3
)
SELECT series_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period_in_term <= span_periods THEN base + (period_in_term <= extra_periods) ELSE 0 END) AS earned_cents,
       SUM(base * MAX(span_periods - period_in_term, 0) + MAX(extra_periods - period_in_term, 0)) AS deferred_cents
FROM terms
GROUP BY series_code
ORDER BY series_code;"
}
